description: This file defines the EmploymentContractService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for managing employee contract attachments, including retrieving, saving, and deleting attachments related to employment contracts.

classes.name: EmploymentContractService
classes.description: Service class that manages employee contract attachments including retrieval, saving, and deletion operations.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmploymentContractDao, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentService, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the first employee attachment of type contract for a specific employee number.

methods.name: getContractAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee attachment by attachment ID for a given employee number.

methods.name: saveContractAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment object as a contract attachment.

methods.name: deleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a specified EmployeeAttachment object from the database.
